message: Workspace validation rejected the unregistered 'unassigned' handoff recipient. Corrected only this session's handoff to an explicitly archival self-reference. The session remains offline, the scope released, and no future worker assigned. Research code and all other agents' records are unchanged.

data.root_cause: ValidationMixin requires both from_agent and to_agent to be registered agent identities; unassigned is not a supported sentinel.
